description: This file defines the `iCalLastImport` class, which manages calendar import records for a CRM system, including operations to set data fields, save to a database, clear records for a user, and undo imports.

classes.name: iCalLastImport
classes.description: Class for managing calendar last import data, including clearing records, saving new import info, and undoing imports.

methods.name: clearRecords
methods.description: Deletes all import records for a specific user from the database table.

methods.name: setFields
methods.description: Sets internal data fields with provided key-value pairs.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Inserts the current data into the database, creating the table if necessary.

methods.name: undo
methods.description: Marks records as deleted for a specific module and user, effectively undoing the import.
